code_prompt_defaults.object_description_single_row: a short face-up domino chain across the top with one row of loose face-up dominoes below
code_prompt_defaults.object_description_two_row: a short face-up domino chain across the top with two rows of loose face-up dominoes below
code_prompt_defaults.connection_rule_text: A loose domino can connect to the open right end if either half has the same number of pips as that open end.
code_prompt_defaults.pip_sum_rule_text: The pip sum of a domino is the total number of pips across its two halves.
code_prompt_defaults.double_rule_text: A double has the same number of pips on both halves.
code_prompt_defaults.second_play_rule_text: Exactly one loose domino can connect directly to `REF`; after playing it, count the remaining loose dominoes that could connect to the new open end.
code_prompt_defaults.extendable_first_play_rule_text: Count loose dominoes that can connect directly to `REF` and would leave a new open end that at least one remaining loose domino could connect to.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_matching_end_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every loose domino that matches the `REF` tile's open right end
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_higher_sum_than_referenc: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every loose domino with a larger pip sum than `REF`
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_sum_to_target_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every loose domino with the target pip sum
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_double_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every loose domino that is a double
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_second_play_candidate_co: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every remaining loose domino that could be played second on the new open end
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_extendable_first_play_co: set "annotation" to a JSON array of bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] for every loose domino that can be played on `REF` and would allow a second play afterward
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_matching_end_count: set "answer" to the count of loose dominoes that match the `REF` tile's open right end
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_higher_sum_than_reference_co: set "answer" to the count of loose dominoes with a larger pip sum than `REF`
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_sum_to_target_count: set "answer" to the count of loose dominoes with the target pip sum
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_double_count: set "answer" to the count of loose doubles
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_second_play_candidate_count: set "answer" to the count of remaining loose dominoes that could be played second
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_extendable_first_play_count: set "answer" to the count of loose dominoes that can be played first and would allow a second play afterward
